div.span: Every distribution shares EdgeWaf: the full MCP rule stack from the blog (IP reputation, rate limits per IP, initialize and tool, Bot Control, body size, protocol version, tool allowlist, SSRF, SQLi and XSS in arguments). A viewer-request CloudFront Function on each pattern distribution pre-filters tokens.

div.span: Each serves MCP at its root /mcp and the RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, so you can lift out the one pattern you need.

div.span: Every pattern ends in the same hello-world MCP server; they differ in the origin and in how it is locked to CloudFront: a WAF-checked secret header (1), VPC origin and private network (2, 5), or OAC with SigV4 (4). Pattern 3 (EKS) is guidance on the pattern 5 model.

div.span: A single user pool issues client-credentials tokens with one scope per pattern (mcp/agentcore, mcp/api-gateway, mcp/web-function, mcp/alb). The edge decodes; each origin verifies the signature and its own scope.
